cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.
